decision.simpleLowercase: Use native toLowerCase with the scalar return-type adapter for the demonstrated contract; original signed32 out-of-range identity must remain explicit. All1114112 valid Unicode codepoints, including surrogates, agree in both tested engines.
decision.simpleUppercase: Native whole-string uppercase is not a replacement for original scalar uppercase:102 total mismatches,27 reached by original LowerToUpper fallback.
decision.titlecase: No standard titlecase scalar API; uppercase candidate has160 mismatches,77 reached by original ToTitle fallback.
decision.fold: No standard Unicode case-fold mapping API; lowercase candidate has198 mismatches,184 reached by SimpleFolding and181 by FullFolding fallback.
decision.scope: Pinned scalar dependency only. This does not prove whole-string/locale CharClass correspondence, full-string casing, arbitrary browser versions, older Unicode engines, other ICU services or complete library parity.
